correctness.rationale: PASS. Sorting each four-digit input into A≥B≥C≥D yields u=A-D, v=B-C with 1≤u≤b−1 and 0≤v≤u. Direct subtraction gives Y=(b³−1)u+(b²−b)v, injective by reducing modulo b and realizable for every pair. Choosing D in b−u ways and the internal gap s in 0..u−v yields permutation totals 12u−4 at v=0, 24(u−v) at 0<v<u, and 6 at v=u. Constant strings give exactly b zero preimages. Quadratic optimization of the interior branch gives 24 floor((b−1)²/4) for b≥3, with parity-dependent tie count, versus 8 at b=2. Positive image pairs fill an integer triangle; under uniform image output the interior Riemann-sum limit has density two on s,t>0,s+t<1 and Q=24st. Integrating its hyperbolic tail yields the displayed sqrt/log law supported on [0,6]. An independently written exact direct enumeration matched every output fiber, maximum, and mass for bases 2 through 14; finite checks only corroborate the symbolic all-base proof.
